provenance.source: The adopted sand-apron whole-look package at de0588a1; palettes, targets and the five-frame protection polygons from the recorded Fern review sample (next-looks-20260911/fern, scripts/prepare.py, 11 September 2026).
provenance.regionRule: A pixel is fur when its exact source RGB is a fur palette member, or cloth when it is a cloth palette member, and it is not a declared protected shadow pixel. Every other pixel and the whole alpha channel are unchanged.
provenance.shadowRule: The one shared shadow brown #ae7146 appears both as fur shading and as warm hand/foot/mouth shadow. The recorded sample disambiguated it with five hand-authored polygons; every other frame uses the shared rule: a #ae7146 pixel is protected when it is 4-connected to a skin-colour pixel through #ae7146 and skin colours.
provenance.foregroundRule: Every foreground sprite is protected in full: it is never recoloured and its alpha is never changed.
provenance.notDone: No adopted PNG byte was changed. No image API and no new original image was used.
provenance.haloRule: The halo anchor is the centre x of the topmost eight opaque rows, with y set one row above the sprite's topmost opaque pixel. The halo ring is drawn in code from that anchor, so it floats above the opaque crown and overwrites no pixel that was opaque in the source. This is a drawing rule and not a measured attachment: no world measured the table, hand-to-book or stool contact.
